model.name: Qwen3.8-27B
model.description: Dense 27B open-weight vision-language model in the Qwen3.8 family: native image and video understanding, thinking mode on by default, Apache 2.0 license.

sources.title: Open-weight release
sources.notes: Native context length is 262,144 tokens, extensible to 1,000,000 with RoPE scaling; vision-language model accepting image and video input; Apache 2.0 license; thinking mode is on by default with reasoning_effort control.

sources.title: Model Studio model pricing
